name: Biobot Surgical
description: Biobot Surgical Pte Ltd is a medical robotics company founded in 2007 in Singapore as a spin-off from Nanyang Technological University and Singapore General Hospital. The company develops the [iSR'obot Mona Lisa](/robot/biobot_mona_lisa) robotic needle-guidance system for transperineal prostate biopsy and focal therapy, and formed the Shanghai Intbot Robotics joint venture with [MicroPort MedBot](/company/microport_medbot) for commercialization in China.
